comment: This is the one voice in the plugin whose oscillators are not doubled: src/modules/HiHat.hh:159 sets each phase increment to (frequency + offset) * rSampleRate with no factor of two, so the printed 1kHz to 2kHz is what is heard. The six offsets are at :168-169; the manual says four oscillators. Open decay is 50ms to 250ms at :145-149 where the tooltip and the manual say 300ms. Closed decay is a fixed 10ms at :112. Thickness does two jobs at :129-136: the makeup gain falls from 10 to 2 as the knob rises, and the highpass corner is mapped backwards, 10000Hz at the bottom of the knob to 1000Hz at the top. Choke is read at :62 and works by zeroing the open hat's decay coefficient for that sample, which empties the envelope.
